title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: This document outlines a decision made by the AI Office, detailing the chosen course of action regarding AI initiatives. It explains the rationale, intended outcomes, and any relevant policies or guidelines.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy explains that a new vacancy has opened for technology specialists in an AI office and details the qualifications and expertise required for the role. It also outlines the recruitment process, responsibilities, and expectations for these specialists to support and advance the office’s AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The document announces an open position for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. The role involves guiding scientific strategy, overseeing research initiatives, and ensuring ethical AI development.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy explains how to fill vacant legal officer roles in the AI department, ensuring that qualified candidates are chosen to support compliance and governance. It outlines the duties, required qualifications, and selection process for these positions, stressing the importance of ethical oversight and regulatory adherence.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This policy explains how to fill vacant positions in the AI office, focusing on the role of policy officers. It outlines the rules and responsibilities for hiring these officers and the duties they will perform to keep the AI office running smoothly.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts who evaluate and advise on the European AI Act, ensuring the regulation is grounded in evidence and best practices. They provide recommendations to lawmakers on safeguards, risk assessment, and compliance measures to make AI systems safer and more trustworthy.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The draft outlines a request to establish standardized guidelines and practices for AI systems. It aims to ensure consistency, safety, and interoperability across AI technologies through agreed‑upon standards.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The document announces a consultation for the Community of Practice (CoP). It invites stakeholders to provide input and participate in shaping the CoP’s policies and activities.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document announces a call for people or organizations to express interest in forming or joining a Community of Practice around AI policy. It invites participants to share their backgrounds and motivations, and explains how to submit their expressions of interest and what the community hopes to achieve.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The document presents a graphic overview of the iterative drafting process used by the Community of Practice. It outlines each step—from initial drafting to review, feedback, and revision—in a clear, step‑by‑step visual format.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document is a visual timeline that maps out the drafting process for a Community of Practice (CoP). It shows the key stages—from initial planning and stakeholder consultation through revisions and final approval—highlighting major milestones and decision points along the way.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: The document presents the initial draft of guidelines for AI use, detailing expectations for responsible design, deployment, and governance. It serves as a framework for stakeholders to promote transparency, safety, and accountability in AI systems.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document presents the second draft of a Code of Practice, offering detailed guidelines for professionals on how to conduct themselves. It outlines expectations for behavior, responsibilities, and procedures to promote ethical and effective practice.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document is the third draft of a code of practice, setting out guidelines for responsible AI development and use. It outlines best practices, compliance requirements, and expectations for stakeholders to ensure ethical and safe AI deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes an international agreement to guide the safe and responsible development of artificial intelligence, emphasizing shared values like transparency, fairness, and accountability. It recommends coordinated research, policy alignment, and monitoring systems to manage risks while fostering innovation across governments, industry, and civil society.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that outlines principles and responsibilities for the safe and ethical development and use of artificial intelligence. It sets guidelines for transparency, accountability, and collaboration among stakeholders to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The policy outlines specific AI practices that are disallowed. It provides detailed rules on which actions are prohibited and explains the reasoning behind those restrictions.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: The document outlines the criteria and parameters used to classify a system as an AI system, including its functional capabilities, underlying technologies, and intended use cases. It provides a standard definition to ensure consistent identification and regulatory compliance across organizations and jurisdictions.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies to promote communication and collaboration among startups, aiming to accelerate innovation. It focuses on providing resources, partnerships, and funding mechanisms to empower new businesses and foster a dynamic entrepreneurial ecosystem.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a program that helps new companies build high‑performance computing skills and access powerful supercomputing resources. It offers training, mentorship, and funding support so start‑ups can develop and run advanced computational solutions.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar presents a slideshow covering key concepts in risk management. It aims to equip attendees with practical tools to identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks in their organizations.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This document outlines a webinar on risk management, highlighting the importance of identifying potential risks in AI projects. It discusses practical steps and best practices to mitigate those risks and ensure responsible AI deployment.
